name: Starfield Tundra
desc:
Starfield Tundra is an area in Upper [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa). It can be found by turning right after climbing up to the upper area of Minityrsa. The [Soothsayer](entity:soothsayer) can be found here.

Starfield Tundra is a **Voidzone**, meaning you will be sent to [The Depths](location:the_depths) if you die on the island regardless of other influences.
additional_info:
-   This area is one of three areas that contain a Star Tree, alongside the [Starfield Veldt](location:starfield_veldt) and [Starfield Grove](location:starfield_grove).
-   The entrance to the Starfield Tundra is located to the right of the guild banner when facing towards the golem construct's area.
